ViewFactory

class ViewFactory[source]

Bases: object

Factory of factories for the application and game views.

It is the central point for getting the application view factory and the view factory of each installed game.

Attributes:
_game_factoriesdict[str, object], class attribute

Game view factory instances (GameViewFactoryProtocol) by game ID, filled by discover_games.

_game_metadatadict[str, GameMetadata], class attribute

Metadata of the games that have a view factory, by game ID.

Methods

get_app_view_factory()

Return the factory for application views.

get_games_metadata()

Return the metadata of the installed games.

discover_games()

Load the view factories declared by the games.

get_game_view_factory(name)

Return the view factory of a game.

get_game_metadata(name)

Return the metadata of a game with a view factory.

static discover_games()[source]

Load the view factories declared in the game metadata.

Notes

For each game whose metadata has view_factory (a dotted path "package.module.ClassName"), the module is imported, the class is instantiated and the instance is stored with the game metadata under the game ID. Games without view_factory are skipped. Import errors are not caught.
